t: Titan 300W corded multi-tool delivers efficient, versatile cutting, sanding, and scraping capabilities across wood, plasterboard, plastics and non-ferrous metals. The quick-change multi-tool is ideal for kitchen fitters and decorators undertaking renovation or repair work. Features 6-speed variable control to ensure precise speed adjustment for different tasks, and a tool-free blade change system to allow rapid accessory swaps. The fan-cooled motor provides reliable performance during extended use. Also equipped with soft-grip handle and lock-on trigger switch to enhance comfort during longer use, and a universal clamping system for supporting both U- and O-type accessories.
